name: A Kiss from Death
source:
Your life is peaceful until you are involved in a mysterious accident that takes away your ability to see. After receiving a cornea transplant from your father who is a highly skilled surgeon and regaining your sight, it feels as if you are on the road to recovery. However, your new eyes hold an unusual ability… to see evil spirits. In the process of running away from an evil spirit, you encounter three handsome strangers who save you and then claim themselves to be grim reapers. Knowing that your newfound powers could cost you your life, they offer you protection… as live-in bodyguards?!

Will you let yourself be protected by the grim reapers and uncover the secrets behind your eyes?
translation:
你的生活很平静，直到你卷入一场神秘的事故，导致你失去了视力。在接受了一位技术精湛的外科医生父亲的角膜移植手术并恢复视力后，感觉好像你正在康复之路上。然而，你的新眼睛拥有一种不寻常的能力……可以看到邪灵。在逃离恶灵的过程中，你遇到了三个英俊的陌生人，他们救了你，然后自称是死神。知道你新发现的力量可能会夺去你的生命，他们为你提供保护……作为住家保镖？！

你愿意让自己受到死神的保护并揭开你眼睛背后的秘密吗？
